$Comment: Artillery XP for the Lantern Bombs, on a server running MMO Skill Tree: one row on the Artillery
track's own table, beside the rows MMO Skill Tree ships for it. Requires takes this file out on a
server without MMO Skill Tree, where there is no Artillery track to pay; always write it with Min 1.
A thrown bomb bursts after it leaves the hand, so by the time it lands the thrower may hold
something else, or nothing once the stack runs out. A tag: row ties the hit to the Hit tag every
blast and shard carries instead of to whatever is in hand, so every hit the burst lands trains
Artillery and takes Artillery's damage bonuses (the MMO layer of the Hallowed set raises them). A
tag: row is checked before cause: rows, so the bursts' Fire damage pays Artillery and never a
school's Fire row. The value is the XP each hit pays. The bombs in hand need no row: each tier
carries the game's Bomb weapon Family, which MMO Skill Tree's own Artillery table already covers.
